as_told.title: Edgar Mitchell's telepathic conversion experience on Apollo 14

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut on Apollo 14, the 1971 NASA mission to the Moon, had a conversion experience on the flight back to Earth. In one telling Michels calls it a telepathic, almost psychic experience that Mitchell spoke about openly and that changed his whole view of the world, which, if true, would mean a trained astronaut came home from the Moon convinced the mind reaches beyond the body.
